doc: How sxs/decide.py chooses on popups and cards. Rules are tried in order; the first whose 'when' holds and whose 'match' regex finds the card's title or body wins. 'choose' is a regex for the button to press, or 'dismiss' (back arrow or tap outside), or 'cancel' (the dialog's Cancel button). Goals: explore (finish the current Explore quest), daily (daily loop), idle (just get home). Add a rule whenever a new card shows up; anything no rule covers is dismissed and logged as unknown. A dismiss taps outside the card unless the rule says "dismiss_by": "back" (the bottom-left back arrow).

rules.why: Friend, team-up and challenge requests from other players: social choices are mae's, so leave them untouched.
Lost a fight. OK goes home; Cancel would leave the character stranded at 0 HP.
The tracked quest's Go button wants to travel home to reach its content (e.g. the Fantasia Ascent tower). Travel only, nothing spent.
Low HP after a fight. Quick Heal eats cooked dishes (Green Riceball, made in the Alchemy Pot), not premium currency, and keeps the run going.
Low HP and nothing to do out here: go home.
Quest detail from the tracker: Go travels to the quest, Track turns tracking on.
Not working on quests right now.
Travel prompts from the quest tracker; free.
Not travelling when the goal is just to get home.
Activating a portal is free, counts toward exploration and unlocks fast travel.
The Voyage Obelisk is the gate to the next kingdom (Originisle V → Verdantglade); the quest marker points at it, and activating it is free.
Unlocking a Goddess Statue once the area is 100% explored blesses the land (+1 Blessing Level, which feeds the Bed's AFK EXP). Free; it's the follow-up quest 'The Goddess's Grace'.
Structures on the map are mini-dungeons with floors of fights; clearing them counts toward Explore quests.
Skip mini-dungeons when not exploring or when HP is low.
Floor cleared; keep climbing while healthy.
Leave the dungeon (back arrow) when HP is low.
